title: Terminal
about: A green-phosphor screen with a status bar and sheet counter; a button turns it into an ink-saving paper printout, and it can come with its envelope.

fields.prop_device: The machine's name in the status bar, e.g. RELAY STATION KESTREL · MAINTENANCE LOG (TERMINAL OUTPUT when left out)
fields.prop_plate: A caption above the sheets on screen; it never prints
fields.prop_envelope: A word written on an envelope, printed as a last sheet; no envelope when left out
fields.prop_frank: The postage frank on the envelope, e.g. RELAY POST
fields.prop_frank_amount: The amount under the frank, e.g. 12 SCRIP
fields.prop_font: A Google Fonts handwriting family for the envelope word, e.g. Reenie Beanie; a printed label when left out
